title: Juicy Greek Tofu Gyro
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Greek dish featuring yeasty and pillowy pita bread filled with juicy tofu and fish seasoning, served in a gyro form.

ingredients.name: Extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into thin strips

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Wrap the pita bread in foil and warm it in the oven for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the fish seasoning, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Add the tofu strips to the bowl and marinate for at least 10 minutes.
Grill or saute the tofu strips until they are golden brown and crispy.
Assemble the gyro by spreading a layer of feta cheese on the pita bread, followed by a few strips of tofu, some diced tomato, sliced red onion, and sliced cucumber.
Drizzle the remaining marinade over the top of the gyro and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Boil some water and blanch the sliced cucumber for 30 seconds to remove excess moisture.
